t: This machine mixes primal dye colours to create the colours of the rainbow.$(br2)For example: If the requested $(6)dye$() is white, it will need 1 of $(4)Red$(0), $(2)Green$(0) and $(1)Blue$(0).$(br)It will consume $(6)30$()RF/t
该机器混合原始染料，以合成彩虹七色。$(br2)例如：若需合成$(6)白色$()染料，则需各1份$(4)红色$(0)、$(2)绿色$(0)与$(1)蓝色$(0)染料。$(br)每次运行消耗$(6)30$()RF/t。
